concept.description: Labels the execute method of org.quartz.Job implementations as :ScheduledJob.
concept.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:IMPLEMENTS|EXTENDS*1..3]->(:Type {fqn: 'org.quartz.Job'}) MATCH (t)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method {name: 'execute'}) SET m:ScheduledJob RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS QuartzJobs

concept.description: Labels @SchedulerLock methods (ShedLock) and @DisallowConcurrentExecution Quartz jobs as :DistributedLock.
concept.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method) WHERE m.name IS NOT NULL AND ( EXISTS { MATCH (m)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(ax:Type) WHERE ax.fqn IN ['net.javacrumbs.shedlock.spring.annotation.SchedulerLock'] } OR (EXISTS { MATCH (t)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(ax:Type) WHERE ax.fqn IN ['org.quartz.DisallowConcurrentExecution'] } AND m.name = 'execute')) SET m:DistributedLock RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS Locks
